description: hddtools is an R package for finding and retrieving hydrological data, preserved in the rOpenSci archive. It provides functions for provider catalogues, selecting observations and parsing returned files. Its retained documentation names GRDC, Data60UK, MOPEX, Scottish river levels and the Koppen climate classification. These cover different regions and periods; the package does not promise a uniform global observation record. A modeller can use the functions to prepare river-flow or precipitation inputs for water-supply and flood studies. The source remains publicly accessible on GitHub and its package metadata specifies GPL-3. The main limitation is its archived, unsupported status: upstream services and historical retrieval methods may have changed. Redistribution terms for retrieved data remain provider-specific and are separate from the software licence. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review checked the retained code metadata and documentation, without running requests for hydrological datasets. The code is available free of charge under its stated licence.
